note_gaps: Success-threshold definition is inconsistent within the paper itself (90% of motion range in the general task description vs. 80% of joint limits in the RL-evaluation paragraph for drawers), not reconciled by the authors.
contact_model: Rigid-body contact with convex-decomposed collision meshes (PhysX 4.1); three joint systems offered (kinematic, dynamic, and PhysX articulation) trading control accuracy against speed.
solver: PhysX 4.1's internal rigid-body solver, used as-is; no LCP/PGS/TGS name or iteration count given in the paper.
throughput: ~5000 Hz engine, ~700 Hz OpenGL render; single-instance CPU-physics figure with no parallel environments, on a laptop with a 2.2 GHz Intel i7-8750 CPU and an Nvidia GeForce RTX 2070 GPU.
